name: meepcoin-local-browser-miner-slice
description: Local, synthetic, voluntary browser-to-pool mining slice (Phase 1B). Not a published package.

scripts.verify: npm run test:v2 && npm run test:vectors:legacy && npm run test:slice

//scripts.test:v2: REQUIRED for this slice. Frozen MeepHash-W v2 native/Wasm equivalence, 20 committed vectors from meepow/vectors/vectors_v2.txt. This is the regression that covers the algorithm the browser actually runs.
//scripts.test:vectors:legacy: algoVersion 0 LEGACY fast/dev vectors (132 of them). Kept as a separate regression. These are NOT v2 vectors and prove nothing about frozen v2.
//scripts.verify: Runs test:v2, then test:vectors:legacy, then test:slice, and fails if any of them fails.
//scripts.test:native: Focused subset of test:slice: the helper protocol suite, the dual-verifier cross-check, the fail-closed acceptance fence, WSL process observation, the ownership graph, the build-source identity and the CLI shutdown controller. All are ALREADY inside test:slice; this target exists only to run them alone while working on the helper. dual_verifier.test.mjs needs the helper build (npm run build:native-helper) and reports itself SKIPPED -- never passed -- if it is missing.
//scripts.build:native-helper: Builds meepow-v2-helper into meepow/build/native-helper/ (gitignored) via WSL. NOT run automatically by the pool or by any test: the pool refuses to start dual verification rather than building anything behind your back.
//scripts.smoke:browser: Optional. Needs an already-installed Chrome/Chromium/Edge; installs nothing and prints SKIPPED if none is found.
